files.description: Scope: simulated teaching and counselling communication, not care delivery
PICO, reproducible PubMed query construction and search literacy
Bias appraisal, evidence assessment and study design
Structured evidence synthesis, GRADE, source traceability
Scientific education: physiology, populations, causality, research
WHO/UNICEF-style communication skills, fictional role-play, teach-back
Educational skill rating rubric for fictional consultations
Instructional method, MCQ/OSCE and no-answer leakage
Mandatory anti-fabrication and medical education safeguards
L0–L3 URL evidence and access verification labels
Mandatory live searching, rewrite and change-log process
Verified-at-authorship reference starting points; recheck links in each run

guidelines: All paths relative to SKILL.md. Teaching only: evidence reading, scientific literacy and fictional communication training. No patient care, health record processing or clinical workflow.
